# Published-progress recovery classifier

This directory owns the pure Phase 8.6.5b layer-2 classifier for an interrupted validation packet whose repository effect was already published as an exact open pull request.

The classifier is deliberately pure. It has no filesystem, process, Git, GitHub, network, device, lease mutation, holder mutation, merge, release, or production authority.

Positive disposition: PUBLISHED_PROGRESS_REBIND_ELIGIBLE.

Positive classification requires exact packet/stage, active D-013, exact D-014, exact holder, reviewed owner-session ABSENT, clean workspace, exact local/remote/open-PR head identity, exact changed paths, descendant proof from the lease base, and a PROVEN read-only D-013 release plan.

Current-main freshness and BEHIND status are outside this classifier. They belong to later validation/currentization.

The result is classification evidence only. All authority flags remain false.
